name: io.github.asinha07/spoor
title: Spoor
description: What changed across metrics, logs and traces, and where it started (Grafana, Victoria, New Relic).

environmentVariables.name: SPOOR_METRICS_TYPE
environmentVariables.description: Backend for metrics: victoriametrics (default), prometheus or newrelic

environmentVariables.name: SPOOR_LOGS_TYPE
environmentVariables.description: Backend for logs: victorialogs (default), loki or newrelic

environmentVariables.name: SPOOR_TRACES_TYPE
environmentVariables.description: Backend for traces: victoriatraces (default), tempo or newrelic

environmentVariables.name: SPOOR_METRICS_URL
environmentVariables.description: Metrics backend URL (VictoriaMetrics or Prometheus) as seen from the container, e.g. http://host.docker.internal:8428

environmentVariables.name: SPOOR_LOGS_URL
environmentVariables.description: Logs backend URL (VictoriaLogs or Loki) as seen from the container, e.g. http://host.docker.internal:9428

environmentVariables.name: SPOOR_TRACES_URL
environmentVariables.description: Traces backend URL (VictoriaTraces or Tempo) as seen from the container, e.g. http://host.docker.internal:10428

environmentVariables.name: SPOOR_METRICS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token for the metrics backend, if it requires one

environmentVariables.name: SPOOR_LOGS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token for the logs backend, if it requires one

environmentVariables.name: SPOOR_TRACES_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token for the traces backend, if it requires one

environmentVariables.name: NEW_RELIC_ACCOUNT_ID
environmentVariables.description: New Relic account ID, for signals of type newrelic

environmentVariables.name: NEW_RELIC_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: New Relic User API key (NRAK-...), for signals of type newrelic
